messages:
auditor-kate: Hi all — fieldwork team asked for a compact evidence bundle for the 2025-11-03 incident interval. Scope: RBAC modifications, KMS decrypts/rotations, PR approvals that changed service account bindings, and vuln-fix rollout proof. Need verifiable ordering and signed manifests. Request deadline: EOD PT today.

marco: We can do a signed bundle. Want raw CloudTrail logs or filtered artifacts + signed index? We usually provide filtered artifacts plus a signed index (sha256) and replay instructions.

auditor-kate: Filtered + signed index is fine. Must include: rolebinding diffs, service-account->key usage events, who approved changes, and key rotation initiator records. Also need a CVE patch rollout matrix.

devops-lee: I'll export RBAC snapshot and PR approval exports. Command I'll use to snapshot k8s state: 

```
kubectl get rolebindings,clusterrolebindings -A -o json > rbac-20251103.json
```

Then I'll generate a signed hash and put both in the pack.

ops-ivy: For KMS decrypts/rotations I'll pull CloudTrail events. Sample AWS CLI query: 

```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --start-time 2025-11-03T00:00:00Z --end-time 2025-11-03T07:00:00Z \
  --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt
```

I will include the event IDs and the full event JSONs.

marco: For approvals: saved approval records live at https://approval.redwood.internal/requests. I'll export request 8429 and 8432 (they're the RBAC change approvals) as JSON and a screenshot.

audit-bot: Evidence bundle job queued: job=evid-20251103-01, ETA 3m. Output target: s3://redwood-audit/evid-20251103.tar.gz :hourglass: 

auditor-kate: Also need chain-of-custody: who handled the artifacts after creation (exporter identity), timestamps, and a signed manifest. Prefer a manifest that lists files with sha256 and a KMS-signed signature.

devops-lee: We'll create manifest like:

```
manifest_version: "1"
signer: "kms:alias/redwood-audit-sign"
signed_at: "2025-11-03T09:30:00Z"
files:
 - rbac-20251103.json
 - cloudtrail-decrypts-20251103.json
 - approvals-8432.json
```

And then sign the manifest with the audit key.

ops-ivy: Vulnerability triage: libc CVE-2025-9999 was patched in the node image at 2025-11-03T03:10:25Z. We need evidence that the fixed image reached Dedicated and Private clusters. I'll produce a CSV mapping cluster, node_image_sha, rollout_time, and service health checks.

marco: I'll attach the infra PR links that changed the RoleBinding and the merge approvals: https://github.com/redwood-infra/infra/pull/5102 and /5099. Those PRs show who approved and when.

audit-bot: Evidence pack created and uploaded. Location: s3://redwood-audit/evid-20251103.tar.gz. Manifest signed: s3://redwood-audit/evid-20251103.manifest.json sha256=bf3a7e9c... :white_check_mark: 

auditor-kate: Perfect. Can we do a short live verification tomorrow at 08:00 PST? I want someone to run the SIEM query and demonstrate verifying the manifest signature.

marco: 08:00 PST works. I'll be on the call to show the approval exports and signature verification steps (I'll use `aws kms verify` + sha256).

devops-lee: I'll be there to replay the RBAC snapshot import into a test cluster for proof-of-order and show rolebinding diffs.

ops-ivy: I'll run the CloudTrail query live and show decrypt events tied to service accounts.

auditor-kate: Thanks — if anything changes DM me. Otherwise I'll download the pack and verify the manifest ahead of the call. Kate
